strategies.text:
Estimated Time to Win: [277.5s - 295.0s]

Time to win varies from 277.5s to 295.0s based on:

  1. Size of battle party (Stays the same after 4 NDW are used)
  2. Latency
  3. Level of execution
  4. Level of counters

Overview:

This is a challenging solo which focuses on, maximizing energy absorbed by Necrozma Dawn Wings (NDW) while minorly using Mega Gengar as a leadoff and Executor.

If TPCing, use Psycho Cut. If not, use Shadow Claw.

Main DPS Strategy:

Mega Gengar:

  1. Leadoff: Mega Gengar's cheaper Shadow Ball is able to deal 200+ damage quickly. This fuels Azelf with over 100 energy so it may begin casting charge moves sooner. When a heavy charge move occurs, e.g: Future Sight or Fire Blast, switch to NDW.
  2. Executor: Mega Gengar can optionally be swapped in to deal a fast knock out blow with shadow ball. This would otherwise outspeed the slower Moongeist Beam.

Necrozma Dawn Wings:

  1. Each NDW casts 2-3 Moongeist Beams; more for against Swift.
  2. Each NDW can comfortably tank: 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts.
  3. Once an active NDW is too low hp to cast another Moongeist Beam, swap to the next one instead of letting it faint.

Advanced DPS Tips [Optional]:

Tick Perfect Cast [TPC]: DPS Increase: ~4.5%

  1. It is extremely helpful to time each Moongeist beam perfectly, especially if chasing a fast time.
  2. In order to TPC, tap slowly as energy nears 100. Just before topping off wait 0.5s for the charge move bubble to appear. Immediately tap Moongeist Beam; if done right it should feel very smooth.

Substitute [Sub]: Consistency Increase

  1. Against Future Sight, Mega Gengar is in danger of being 1 shot when playing in the first slot after the first rejoin. Creating a second battle party (with the same pokemon) where Necrozma Dawn Wings is in the first spot helps overcome this issue.

Time to win varies from 264s to 288s based on:

  1. Size of battle party (Stays the same after 4 NDW are used)
  2. Latency
  3. Level of execution
  4. Level of counters

Overview:

This is a moderate level solo which focuses on, maximizing energy gained on Necrozma Dawn Wings by absorbing charge attacks and well timed rejoins while optionally using Mega Gengar as a leadoff and Executor.

Be advised Future Sight will 1 hit k0 Mega Gengar so it is ideal to either dodge or switch it out. Otherwise, dodging on NDW is not encouraged as this negative hurts energy absorbed energy from Azelf charge moves. Depending on your battle party size this will range anywhere from 2 to 4 rejoins.

Battle Party:

1) Necrozma Dawn Wings will contribute the majority of the DPS.

  1. Each NDW casts 2-3 Moongeist Beams
  2. It can comfortably tank: 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts.
  3. Once the active NDW is too low to cast another Moongeist Beam, swap to the next one.

DPS Tips:

1) Leadoff/Accelerator:

  1. Mega Gengar can optionally be used here to accelerate the boss's aggression early by landing the cheaper cost shadow ball. This allows Azelf to cast charge moves sooner.

2) Tick Perfect Cast [TPC]:

  1. While not required, it is helpful to time each Moongeist beam, especially if running the high energy focused Psycho Cut.
  2. In order to TPC, simply slow down your taps as energy nears 100. Wait a brief moment after the 2nd to last tap and then cast Moongeist Beam. If this strategy isn't preferred, Shadow Claw may be the better option. Time Save: ~10-15s

3) Substitute [Sub]:

  1. Against Future Sight, Mega Gengar is in danger of being 1 shot when playing in the first slot after the first rejoin. Creating a second battle party (with the same pokemon) where Necrozma Dawn Wings is in the first spot helps overcome this issue. Time Save: Varies
